address: 1 Fourth Avenue, Onetangi Beach, Waiheke Island, 1081, New Zealand
bio: This beachfront restaurant commands stunning views, especially at sunset. Since 2020, it has been a popular venue for cocktails and all-day dining thanks to a relaxed vibe and well-crafted dishes. Seafood takes centre stage on the menu – oysters, scallops, market fish, prawns, together with some grilled dishes for meat lovers. Those with ‘menu anxiety’, might want to try the 8-course set. The patio is bliss on balmy days.
